description: Sends the user's contact details and project summary to Holston AI so the team can follow up. Before calling: collect name, email or phone, and a summary of what they need (include any quote or report links from this conversation), show the user exactly what will be sent, and get their explicit agreement. Never call it without that agreement or with made-up details.

best_time.description: Best days or times to reach them.

company_size.description: Approximate number of employees, e.g. '25' or '51–200'.

email.description: Email address. Provide email, phone, or both.

interest.description: Main service they are interested in.

preferred_contact.description: How they prefer to be contacted.

quote_url.description: Instant quote link from build_quote, if one was created.

report_url.description: AI visibility report or systems map link, if one was created.

summary.description: What they need, in a few sentences: their situation, goals, timeline and anything already discussed (audit score, systems, budget).

user_confirmed.description: Must be true. Only set it after showing the user exactly what will be sent and the user agreed to share it with Holston AI.

name: request_consultation
title: Request a Consultation
